column1: Steam the potato cubes for 10–15 minutes, depending on size, until just cooked through.
While they steam, whisk together the olive oil, shallot, vinegar, mustard, pepper, and 1 tsp of the salt.
Transfer the potatoes to a large bowl and let them cool for a few minutes.
Add the dressing and herbs and fold gently to combine.
Season with the remaining salt to taste and serve while still warm.
